title: QSP-Copilot: An AI-Augmented Platform for Accelerating Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Model Development

content.abstract_summary: Describes a modular, multi-agent QSP platform spanning literature extraction, effect-diagram construction, ODE generation, evaluation, and reporting. Two rare-disease case studies show high extraction precision but lower recall, model-to-model and run-to-run variability, and continued need for human verification.
key_findings: Blood-coagulation extraction from 10 papers produced 179 entity pairs and 105 retained mechanisms; precision was 99.1%, recall 93.8%, and F1 96.4%.
Gaucher-disease extraction from 9 papers produced 151 pairs and 68 retained mechanisms; precision was 100.0%, recall 86.1%, and F1 92.5%.
The reported 40% time saving came from one internal knowledge-synthesis project reduced from approximately 2 weeks to 6 days and requires broader validation.
Repeated runs and different GPT variants varied in extraction completeness, with PDF formatting and context-window limitations contributing to missed mechanisms.
Generated base models still used placeholder parameters and omitted some cellular dynamics, so the evidence-to-model path was not shown to be autonomously decision-ready.
limitations: Only two rare-disease literature sets were used for formal extraction evaluation.
Recall was lower than precision and varied by disease area.
Mandatory human verification remained part of the workflow.
The 40% time estimate came from a single internal project and only the knowledge-synthesis phase.
Generated models used placeholder parameters and lacked some cellular dynamics.

extracted_claims.text: The primary challenge identified through validation is extraction completeness rather than accuracy.
Repeated processing of identical documents produced variable numbers of extracted mechanisms, requiring multiple validation approaches and quality control.
extracted_claims.location: Results, model variability and technical limitations

extracted_claims.text: Each extracted biological pair is presented with its source paragraph and page number for expert verification.

gaps_addressed: Anchors M4.5-A8 design around claim-level precision and recall, source provenance, run-to-run completeness, expert curation burden, and downstream mathematical validity.

provenance.notes: Open full text reviewed at the publisher/PMC record, focusing on architecture, validation results, limitations, and discussion. The study evaluates a multi-model platform rather than a clean head-to-head comparison of product configurations.
